C2.headline: Dockworkers reach tentative contract agreement, averting port strike
C2.summary: Longshoremen and port operators reached a tentative wage agreement late Thursday night, officially calling off the planned coast-wide dock strike. Terminals will operate normally with zero work stoppages or cargo delays.

C3.headline: Local soccer club wins regional tournament in dramatic shootout

C7.headline: Huelga indefinida en el puerto de Valencia paraliza la carga de contenedores
C7.summary: Los estibadores del puerto de Valencia han iniciado este lunes una huelga indefinida exigiendo mejoras laborales. Más de cuarenta buques mercantes permanecen fondeados esperando atracar.
